note: Every job type volunteer computers can be given, what it is for, and the recommended state. Retiring is config only (retire_job_types); nothing is deleted.

types.what: Trains a small designer that proposes tiny frozen SNN circuits (3 hidden neurons) for synthetic tasks; shared champion + discoveries gallery.
types.share: Every BugBrain-side job TacoBell ran since Nov 9 was this type: 68,563 runs in its two worker logs (plus about 1,000 sf-propose runs before Nov 20). In the current log 6,274 of 11,307 ended in error, mostly 'Invalid shared inverse training assignment' (being fixed separately).
types.useful: low for the goal: synthetic tiny circuits, no growth, no memory, no link to BugBrain or R144
types.recommend: keep at lower priority once experiments run (experiment jobs are offered first); retire when the gallery is finished
